findings: with hospital-ventilators functional_count at zero: The hospital has had functional_count 0 since the start, and no repair occurs before this assignment. A patient cannot be newly placed on a functional ventilator when none are available. (run log: "t5 clinical-staff did assign-ventilators-v1: hospitalized-flu-patients.patient_group.ventilation_status needs ventilation->ventilated") ALSO: The log previously marked a patient as ventilated, but when the only functional ventilator fails and the count returns to zero, it shows no loss of ventilation, deterioration, or death for that dependent patient. The subsequent repeated repairs and failures likewise leave the patient’s ventilated status unchanged. (run log: "t11 process functional-ventilators-fail: hospital-ventilators.ventilator_stock.functional_count 1->0")
